item.title: Siebold Memorial Museum — Guide
item.description: The Siebold Memorial Museum, in the Narutaki district where the physician once lived, honours Philipp Franz von Siebold, the German doctor who arrived at the Dutch trading post of Dejima in 1823 and became one of the most important figures in the exchange of knowledge between Japan and the West. At his private school Narutaki-juku he taught Western medicine and science to Japanese students, while himself studying and cataloguing Japanese plants, animals and culture, sending vast collections back to Europe that shaped Western understanding of Japan.
